shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo "-----" && find .agents/skills/gravity-ui -type f && echo "-----" && ls -la && cat AGENTS.md | head -100 && echo "-----" && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v "^./.git/" | head -100

cat src/App.tsx && echo "----- main" && cat src/main.tsx && echo "----- index" && cat index.html && echo "----- tsconfig" && cat tsconfig.json && echo "----- vite" && cat vite.config.ts && echo "----- routing top" && sed -n 1,120p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md

cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && echo "-----THEMING" && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -250 && echo "----- inspect" && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh && echo "----- charts in node_modules" && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head

npm view @gravity-ui/charts version peerDependencies dependencies 2>&1 | tail -40; echo "---- uikit peer/version"; node -p "require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').version"; echo "---- react"; node -p "require('./node_modules/react/package.json').version"

npm view @gravity-ui/charts versions --json 2>/dev/null | tail -30; echo "---- peer per version (last 12)"; for v in $(npm view @gravity-ui/charts versions --json 2>/dev/null | node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>{const a=JSON.parse(s);console.log(a.slice(-12).join(" "))})'); do echo -n "$v: "; npm view @gravity-ui/charts@$v peerDependencies --json 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\n '; echo; done

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/.agents/skills/dataviz 2>/dev/null || cd /tmp/claude-1000/bundled-skills/2.1.319/f4aec60818838f54be38b7abcd77ff31/dataviz && pwd && sed -n 1,200p references/anti-patterns.md | head -150; echo "----- marks (line/tooltip parts)"; grep -n -i -A3 "line\|hairline\|marker\|crosshair" references/marks-and-anatomy.md | head -120

npm install @gravity-ui/charts@1.73.0 --save-exact 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn Unknown env" | tail -20; echo "---- package.json deps"; node -p "JSON.stringify(require('./package.json').dependencies,null,2)"; echo "---- installed"; node -p "require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/package.json').version"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/build/docs 2>/dev/null || ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs 2>/dev/null; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/README.md 2>/dev/null | head -120

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts && ls dist/docs/guides; echo "----- theming"; cat dist/docs/guides/theming.md 2>/dev/null | head -150; echo "----- get-started"; sed -n 1,80p dist/docs/get-started.md

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && grep -rn "useThemeValue\|useTheme\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rln "export declare function useThemeValue\|export declare const useThemeValue" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build 2>/dev/null | head -3; echo "----- Chart props"; grep -rn "interface ChartProps\|export type ChartProps\|theme" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist | head -30

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts && cat dist/docs/guides/colors.md | head -120; echo "----- line series"; ls dist/docs/guides/series-types; sed -n 1,80p dist/docs/guides/series-types/line.md 2>/dev/null

ls dist/esm | head -30; grep -rn "export.*ChartProps\|export declare function Chart\|export const Chart\b" dist/esm --include=*.d.ts | head -5; echo "----- useTheme in charts?"; grep -rl "useThemeValue\|useTheme(" dist/esm --include=*.js 2>/dev/null | head -5

sed -n 15,60p dist/esm/components/index.d.ts; echo "----- default palette / theme-aware"; grep -rn "g-color-\|themeValue\|useThemeValue\|'dark'" dist/esm --include=*.js 2>/dev/null | grep -v "\.d\.ts" | head -25

grep -rn "colors" dist/esm/core/constants/*.js dist/esm/core/constants/defaults/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -10; grep -rln "infographics\|DEFAULT_COLORS\|defaultColors\|PALETTE" dist/esm --include=*.js | head -10
cat dist/esm/core/constants/palette.js | head -60; echo "----- usage"; grep -n "palette\|PALETTE\|colors" dist/esm/components/ChartInner/useChartInnerProps.js | head -15

grep -rn "stroke" dist/esm/plugins/line/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -12; ls dist/esm/plugins | head -30; echo "----- uikit useThemeValue / ThemeContextProps"; cd /home/sandbox/workspace && grep -rn "themeValue" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/*.d.ts | head -8; grep -rn "themeValue" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5

grep -n "RealTheme" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts | head -3; grep -rn "type RealTheme" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -r --include=*.d.ts | head -2; cd node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts && grep -n "color" dist/esm/plugins/line/prepare-line-series.js | head -12; echo "----- how line path stroke is applied"; grep -rln "strokeWidth" dist/esm/core/shapes dist/esm/plugins/line 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rn "'stroke'\|stroke:" dist/esm/core/shapes/line* dist/esm/core/shapes/path* 2>/dev/null | head -8

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs && grep -n -i "categor" guides/axes/axis-types.md | head -12; echo "----- title"; grep -rn -i "title" get-started.md overview.md 2>/dev/null | head -5; grep -rln "title: {" guides/*.md 2>/dev/null | head -3; echo "----- lineWidth / grid"; grep -rn "lineWidth" guides series-types/line.md 2>/dev/null | head -4; grep -rn "grid" guides/axes/index.md 2>/dev/null | head -6; echo "----- tooltip default"; sed -n 1,25p guides/tooltip.md

sed -n 68,100p guides/axes/axis-types.md; echo "----- xAxis / yAxis keys"; grep -rn "xAxis: {\|yAxis: {" guides/axes/*.md | head -4; echo "----- title key"; grep -rn "title: {" guides/*.md guides/axes/*.md | head -4; grep -rn "title" guides/html.md | head -3

sed -n 5,30p guides/axes/axis-types.md; echo "----- title"; sed -n 176,195p guides/html.md; echo "----- labels/ticks"; sed -n 5,20p guides/axes/axis-labels.md; echo "----- legend single?"; grep -n "enabled" guides/legend.md | head -5

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && f=$(grep -rl "g-root_theme_" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm --include=*.js | grep -i "theme" | head -3); echo "$f"; for x in $f; do grep -n "useLayoutEffect\|useEffect\|setThemeValue\|useState\|body\|classList\|getRootClassName" $x | head -20; echo ---; done

grep -rl "useLayoutEffect\|themeValue" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ --include=*.js | head; echo ---; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.js 2>/dev/null | head -80
npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -40
cat .gitignore; echo "----"; git status --short; echo "----"; node -p "require('./package.json').dependencies['@gravity-ui/charts']"; npx tsc --noEmit; echo "tsc exit=$?"
rm -rf dist && git status --short
